title: Eliminate the Bandits
description: The camp is exactly as bad as the guard feared - a dry camp with more supplies than six men need, meaning they were never just passing through. Break it before it grows into something Elder Moor can't scout its way out of.

objectives.description: Cut down the crew - six ambushes on the north road is six too many
Kill the one running the camp - the raids stop when he does

notes: Continuation of bandit_justice_1 - see that file's notes for the north-road threat, the guard's motive, and the unwired consequence of leaving the camp standing.
